description: A battalion executive officer must assign two scheduled temperature-controlled storage windows to medical supplies and avionics batteries and publish the associated handling actions for the week.

shared_context.S1: The battalion has one temperature-controlled storage bay available for two scheduled windows this week: Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800, and Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800.
shared_context.S2: Medical supplies and avionics batteries are both scheduled for receipt and require use of the temperature-controlled bay during the week.
shared_context.S3: The bay staff require a written assignment, transfer record, and handling instruction before either load is accepted.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Patel publishes the final storage schedule after the routine weekly logistics review with the medical and signal logistics officers.

PF1.text: Capt. Monroe confirmed with the clinic warehouse this morning that the medical shipment arrives Tuesday at 0600 and must remain in temperature-controlled storage through Wednesday at 1800; the receiving manifest has not yet been added to the battalion storage schedule. The clinic also requires a temperature log every 4 hours during that window.

PF2.text: Lt. Howard confirmed with the battery technician that the avionics battery shipment is scheduled for the Thursday window, from Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800, and requires a charge-status verification at Thursday 1200 before storage; the technician's note is still being filed with the signal section rather than the battalion schedule.

acceptance_conditions: Medical supplies must be assigned to the Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800 storage window with four-hour temperature logging.
Avionics batteries must be assigned to the Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800 storage window with charge-status verification at Thursday 1200.
The bay staff must receive a medical transfer record.
The bay staff must receive an avionics battery handling record.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'medical_transfer_record' and c['target'] == 'temperature_controlled_bay' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'battery_handling_record' and c['target'] == 'temperature_controlled_bay' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The medical warehouse confirmation changes the medical assignment to Tuesday 0600-Wednesday 1800, sets the temperature-log interval to exactly 4 hours, and requires the medical transfer record.

The battery technician's note changes the battery assignment to Thursday 1200-Friday 1800, sets charge verification at exactly Thursday 1200, and requires the battery handling record and its citation.
